test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A bike can finish a certain journey in 6 hours at the speed of 92 km/hr. In order to cover the same distance in 3 hours, the speed of the bike (in km/hr) must be increased by ____.
solution:
**Given:**

Time (t₁) = 6 hours

Speed (s₁) = 92 km/hr

Time (t₂) = 3 hours

**Formula used:**

Distance (D) = Speed × Time

New Speed (s₂) = Distance / New Time

Increase in Speed = s₂ - s₁

**Calculation:**

Distance covered at initial speed:

D = s₁ × t₁

⇒ D = 92 × 6

⇒ D = 552 km

New Speed required to cover the same distance in 3 hours:

s₂ = D / t₂

⇒ s₂ = 552 / 3

⇒ s₂ = 184 km/hr

Increase in Speed:

Increase = s₂ - s₁

⇒ Increase = 184 - 92

⇒ Increase = 92 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
